explanation: Fires on tokens in machine-formatted text: the last segment of an underscore- or hyphen-joined identifier or URL slug (rm_trig_labels, policy_maps, cosmetic-procedures-wrinkles, skin_infections, next-level), loop and call tokens in code, and table-cell values. A second, weaker trigger is the final word of a quoted problem statement just before the closing quote ('each other"', 'in a row"').
